author: Dragotag
quote:
GTA VI is the new high bar that every game will be compared to. And they will fail for years.
The story is great, it's different from what we used to in gaming, it makes the player responsible for everything, your actions matter, your decisions, and it's not easy because a happy ending requires commitment and taking responsibility.
The music is iconic (but not the best of the year).
I liked the bodcasts system, the new stealing system, how the game makes you care for each dollar you earn and how to spend it.


Is it a perfect game? NO.
There are many things they can fix in updates (glitches, and performance mode).
The ultimate edition benefits don't worth the extra 20$.
And The price of the standard is over priced.

author: Dragotag
quote:
The Defenition of GOAT. 
RDR2 is a must-play game, The characters are well-written and played, The story could have been slow in the beginning but it got better and better with every mission.
A game that will give you something to do when you don't want to play missions, The strangers' and side missions, the activities, and the challenges are very fun to play.
Red dead Redemption 2 is the best and most perfect game has ever been.
